name: Pieter Botha
bio:
Pieter Botha's journey into motorsport HR began unconventionally, after a career in manufacturing. Recognizing the need for robust personnel management within the high-stakes racing environment, he transitioned his skills to motorsport. He has a knack for spotting talent and cultivating a positive team environment. 

Pieter believes in fostering a culture of continuous improvement and open communication. His approach is data-driven, using analytics to track employee performance and identify areas for development. What sets him apart is his experience outside of motorsport which enables him to bring a fresh perspective to the sport.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a receding hairline
physical.description: Pieter is of average height with a slightly weathered face and a kind smile.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations about team dynamics.
Insists on a weekly 'tea time' for informal feedback sessions.
Has a collection of miniature racing helmets on his desk.
